column1: This is where you put your Current Options Records to Upload them to TradeVault.
Make sure to enter Buy or Sell and Put or Call for proper recording.
If there is no Close Date, it will be recorded as an open contract.
If you originally recorded the Open Entry and Close Entry separately, you need to combine them here.
Only enter the Per Contract Broker Fee, the Open and Closed Contacts will be tallied up for the total.
If you previously recorded your Options Trades with only some of them closed, separate open and closed contracts here.
